subject.title: perf(ui): drop typebox from Control UI startup by lazy-loading the approval page

question: Should the protected maintainer-owned Control UI performance change be accepted after the remaining checks complete?
rationale: The implementation has focused live-path evidence and no discrete source defect was established, but the `maintainer` label requires explicit human handling rather than automated cleanup.

options.title: Accept after checks

options.title: Request additional route evidence

recommendation.title: Accept after checks
